steps.title: bhūtōchchāṭana
lines: uttiṣṭhantu । bhūta piśāchāḥ । yē tē bhūmibhārakāḥ ।

steps.title: prāṇāyāmaḥ
lines: ō-mbhūḥ । ō-mbhuvaḥ । ōgṃ suvaḥ । ō-mmahaḥ । ō-ñjanaḥ । ō-ntapaḥ । ōgṃ sa̠tyam ।

steps.title: saṅkalpaḥ
lines: śrī paramēśvara muddisya, śrī paramēśvara prītyartham,
(bhārata dēśaḥ - jambū dvīpē, bharata varṣē, bharata khaṇḍē, mērōḥ dakṣiṇa/uttara digbhāgē;
amērikā - krauñcha dvīpē, ramaṇaka varṣē, aindrika khaṇḍē, sapta samudrāntarē, kapilāraṇyē),
śōbhana gṛhē, samasta dēvatā brāhmaṇa, harihara gurucharaṇa sannithau,
... ṛtē [vasanta, grīṣma, varṣa, śarat, hēmanta, śiśira],
... māsē [chaitra, vaiśākha, jyēṣṭha, āṣāḍha,śrāvaṇa, bhādrapada, āśvayuja, kārtīka, mārgaśīrṣa,puṣya, māgha, phālguṇa],
... vāsarē,[indu/sōma, bhauma/maṅgaḻa, saumya/budha, bṛhaspati/guru, bhṛgu/śukra, sthira/manda/śani, bhānu/ravi/ādi] ...
śubha vāsarē, śubha nakṣatrē, śubha yōgē, śubha karaṇa,
ēvaṅguṇa, viśēṣaṇa, viśiṣṭhāyām, śubha tithau, śrīmān,

steps.title: prātaḥ kāla mantrāchamanaḥ
lines: pāpēbhyō̍ rakṣa̠ntām । yadrātryā pāpa̍ makā̠rṣam । manasā vāchā̍ ha̠stābhyām ।
padbhyā mudarē̍ṇa śi̠ñchā । rātri̠ stada̍valu̠mpatu । yatkiñcha̍ duri̠ta-mmayi̍ ।
idamaha-mmā mamṛ̍ta yō̠ nau । sūryē jyōtiṣi juhō̍mi svā̠hā̎ ॥ (tai. ara. 10. 24)

steps.title: madhyāhna kāla mantrāchamanaḥ
lines: āpa̍ḥ punantu pṛthi̠vī-mpṛ̍thi̠vī pū̠tā pu̍nātu̠ mām ।
pu̠nantu̠ brahma̍ṇa̠spati̠ rbrahmā̍ pū̠tā pu̍nātu̠ mām ।
sarva̍-mpunantu̠ mā māpō̍-'sa̠tāñcha̍ prati̠graha̠gg̠ svāhā̎ ॥ (tai. ara. pariśiṣṭaḥ 10. 30)

steps.title: sāyaṅkāla mantrāchamanaḥ
lines: agni ścha mā manyu ścha manyupataya ścha manyu̍kṛtēbhyaḥ ।
manasā vāchā̍ hastā̠bhyām । padbhyā mudarē̍ṇa śi̠ñchā ।
ida maha-mmā mamṛ̍ta yō̠nau । satyē jyōtiṣi juhōmi svā̠hā ॥ (tai. ara. 10. 24)
āchamya (ō-ṅkēśavāya svāhā, ... śrī kṛṣṇa parabrahmaṇē namō namaḥ)

steps.title: dvitīya mārjanaḥ
lines: da̠dhi̠ krāvṇṇō̍ akāriṣam । ji̠ṣṇō raśva̍sya vā̠ji̍naḥ ।
ōṃ āpō̠ hiṣṭhā ma̍yō̠bhuva̍ḥ । tā na̍ ū̠rjē da̍dhātana ।
tasya̍ bhājayatē̠ ha na̠ḥ । u̠śa̠tīri̍va mā̠tara̍ḥ ।
tasmā̠ ara̍ṅga māma vaḥ । yasya̠ kṣayā̍ya̠ jinva̍tha ।

steps.title: punaḥ mārjanaḥ
lines: hira̍ṇyavarṇā̠ śśucha̍yaḥ pāva̠kāḥ yā su̍jā̠taḥ ka̠śyapō̠ yā svindra̍ḥ ।
a̠gniṃ yā garbha̍ndadhi̠rē virū̍pā̠ stāna̠ āpa̠śśagg syō̠nā bha̍vantu ।
yā sā̠g̠ṃ rājā̠ varu̍ṇō̠ yāti̠ madhyē̍ satyānṛ̠tē a̍va̠paśya̠-ñjanā̍nām ।
ma̠dhu̠ śchuta̠śśucha̍yō̠ yāḥ pā̍va̠kā stāna̠ āpa̠śśagg syō̠nā bha̍vantu ।
yāsā̎-ndē̠vā di̠vi kṛ̠ṇvanti̍ bha̠kṣaṃ yā a̠ntari̍kṣē bahu̠thā bhava̍nti ।
yāḥ pṛ̍thi̠vī-mpaya̍sō̠ndanti̍ śśu̠krāstāna̠ āpa̠śagg syō̠nā bha̍vantu ।
yā-śśi̠vēna̍ mā̠ chakṣu̍ṣā paśyatāpaśśi̠vayā̍ ta̠nu vōpa̍spṛśata̠ tvacha̍ mmē ।
sarvāg̍ṃ a̠gnīgṃ ra̍psu̠ṣadō̍ hu̠vē vō̠ mayi̠ varchō̠ bala̠ mōjō̠ nidha̍tta ॥ (tai. saṃ. 5. 6. 1)

steps.title: aghamarṣaṇa mantraḥ pāpavimōchanaṃ
lines: dru̠pa̠dā di̍va muñchatu । dru̠pa̠dā di̠vē nmu̍muchā̠naḥ ।
pū̠ta-mpavitrē̍ṇē̠ vājya̎ṃ āpa̍ śśundantu̠ maina̍saḥ ॥ (tai. brā. 266)
āchamya (ō-ṅkēśavāya svāhā, ... śrī kṛṣṇa parabrahmaṇē namō namaḥ)

steps.title: laghusaṅkalpaḥ
lines: śubhatithau mamōpātta durita kṣayadvārā śrī paramēśvara muddiśya śrī paramēśvara prītyartha-mprātassandhyāṅga yathā kālōchita arghyapradāna-ṅkariṣyē ॥

steps.title: prātaḥ kālārghya mantraṃ
lines: ō-mbhūrbhuva̠ssuva̍ḥ ॥ tathsa̍vi̠turvarē̎ṇya̠-mbhargō̍ dē̠vasya̍ dhīmahi । dhiyō̠ yō na̍ḥ prachōdayā̎t ॥ 3 ॥

steps.title: mādhyāhnārghya mantraṃ
lines: ōṃ ha̠g̠ṃ saśśu̍chi̠ṣa dvasu̍rantarikṣa̠sa ddōtā̍ vēdi̠ṣadati̍thi rdurōṇa̠sat ।
nṛ̠ṣa dva̍ra̠sa dṛ̍ta̠sa dvyō̍ma̠ sada̠bjā gō̠jā ṛ̍ta̠jā a̍dri̠jā ṛ̠tam-bṛ̠hat ॥ (tai. ara. 10. 4)

steps.title: sāya-ṅkālārghya mantraṃ
lines: ō-mbhūḥ । ō-mbhuvaḥ । ōgṃ suvaḥ । ō-mmahaḥ । ō-ñjanaḥ । ō-ntapaḥ । ōgṃ sa̠tyam ।

steps.title: kālātikramaṇa prāyaśchittaṃ
lines: pūrvōkta ēvaṅguṇa viśēṣaṇa viśiṣṭhāyāṃ śubhatithau mamōpātta durita kṣayadvārā śrī paramēśvara muddiśya śrī paramēśvara prītyartha-ṅkālātikrama dōṣaparihārārtha-ñchaturtha arghyapradāna-ṅkariṣyē ॥
ō-mbhūḥ । ō-mbhuvaḥ । ōgṃ suvaḥ । ō-mmahaḥ । ō-ñjanaḥ । ō-ntapaḥ । ōgṃ sa̠tyam ।

steps.title: sajala pradakṣiṇaṃ
lines: brahmai̠va san-brahmā̠pyēti̠ ya ē̠vaṃ vēda ॥ asāvādityō brahma ॥ (tai. ara. 2. 2)

steps.title: sandhyāṅga tarpaṇaṃ
lines: āchamya (ō-ṅkēśavāya svāhā, ... śrī kṛṣṇa parabrahmaṇē namō namaḥ)

steps.title: prātaḥkāla tarpaṇaṃ
lines: mama upātta samasta duritakṣayadvāra śrī paramēśvara prītyardha-mprāta-ssandyānga tarpaṇa-ṅkariṣye

steps.title: gāyatrī avāhana
lines: ōjō̍-'si̠ sahō̍-'si̠ bala̍masi̠ bhrājō̍-'si dē̠vānā̠-ndhāma̠nāmā̍si̠ viśva̍masi vi̠śvāyu̠-ssarva̍masi sa̠rvāyu-rabhibhūrōm ।
gāyatriyā gāyatrī chChandō viśvāmitraṛṣi ssavitā dēvatā-'gnirmukhaṃ
brahmā śirō viṣṇurhṛdayagṃ rudra-śśikhā pṛthivī yōniḥ
prāṇāpāna vyānōdāna samānā saprāṇā śvētavarṇā sāṅkhyāyana sagōtrā gāyatrī chaturvigṃ śatyakṣarā
ō-mbhūḥ । ō-mbhuvaḥ । ōgṃ suvaḥ । ō-mmahaḥ । ō-ñjanaḥ । ō-ntapaḥ । ōgṃ sa̠tyam ।
āchamya (ō-ṅkēśavāya svāhā, ... śrī kṛṣṇa parabrahmaṇē namō namaḥ)

steps.title: gāyatrī japasaṅkalpaḥ
lines: śrī paramēśvara muddisya śrī paramēśvara prītyarthaṃ

steps.title: aṅganyāsaḥ
lines: dhiyō̠ yō na̍ḥ jñānātmanē nētratrayāya vauṣaṭ ।

steps.title: gāyatrī mantraṃ
lines: ō-mbhūrbhuva̠ssuva̍ḥ ॥ tathsa̍vi̠turvarē̎ṇyaṃ̠ bhargō̍ dē̠vasya̍ dhīmahi । dhiyō̠ yō na̍ḥ prachōdayā̎t ॥

steps.title: japāvasanam
lines: āchamya (ō-ṅkēśavāya svāhā, ... śrī kṛṣṇa parabrahmaṇē namō namaḥ)
mama upātta samasta duritakṣayadvāra śrī paramēśvara prītyartha-mprātassandyāṅga gāyatrī mahāmantra japāvasana-ṅkariṣyē ।

steps.title: aṅganyāsaḥ
lines: dhiyō̠ yō na̍ḥ jñānātmanē nētratrayāya vauṣaṭ ।

steps.title: aṣṭamudrā pradarśanaṃ
lines: surabhirjñāna chakrē cha yōniḥ kūrmō-'tha paṅkajam । [surabhirjñāna nētra-ñcha]
āchamya (ō-ṅkēśavāya svāhā, ... śrī kṛṣṇa parabrahmaṇē namō namaḥ)

steps.title: prātaḥkāla sūryōpasthānaṃ
lines: ō-mmi̠trasya̍ cha̠rṣaṇī̠ dhṛta̠ śravō̍ dē̠vasya̍ sāna̠ sim ।
mi̠trō janān̍ yātayati prajā̠na-nmi̠trō dā̍dhāra pṛthi̠vī mu̠tadyām ।
mi̠traḥ kṛ̠ṣṭī rani̍miṣā̠-'bhi cha̍ṣṭē sa̠tyāya̍ ha̠vya-ṅghṛ̠tava̍dvidhēma ।
prasami̍ttra̠ martyō̍ astu̠ praya̍svā̠ nyasta̍ āditya̠ śikṣa̍ti vra̠tēna̍ ।
na ha̍nyatē̠ na jī̍yatē̠ tvōtō̠naina̠ magṃhō̍ aśnō̠ tyanti̍tō̠ na dū̠rāt ॥ (tai. saṃ. 3.4.11)

steps.title: madhyāhna sūryōpasthānaṃ
lines: ōṃ ā sa̠tyēna̠ raja̍sā̠ varta̍mānō nivē̠śa̍ya nna̠mṛta̠-mmartya̍ñcha ।
hi̠raṇyayē̍na savi̠tā rathē̠nā-'dē̠vō yā̍ti̠ bhuva̍nā ni̠paśyan̍ ॥
udva̠ya ntama̍sa̠ spari̠ paśya̍ntō̠ jyōti̠ rutta̍ram ।
aprā̠ dyāvā̍ pṛthi̠vī anta̠ri̍kṣa̠gṃ sūrya̍ ā̠tmā jaga̍ta sta̠sthuṣa̍ścha ॥

steps.title: sāyaṅkāla sūryōpasthānaṃ
lines: ōṃ i̠mammē̍ varuṇa śṛdhī̠ hava̍ ma̠dyā cha̍ mṛḍaya । tvā ma̍va̠syu rācha̍kē ॥
tatvā̍ yāmi̠ brahma̍ṇā̠ vanda̍māna̠ sta dāśā̎stē̠ yaja̍mānō ha̠virbhi̍ḥ ।
ahē̍ḍamānō varuṇē̠ha bō̠dhyuru̍śa̠g̠ṃ samā̍na̠ āyu̠ḥ pramō̍ṣīḥ ॥
yachchi̠ddhitē̠ viśō̍yathā̠ pradē̍va varuṇavra̠tam । mi̠nī̠masi̠dya vi̍dyavi ।

steps.title: digdēvatā namaskāraḥ
lines: ō-nnama̠ḥ prāchyai̍ di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।
ō-nnamō dakṣi̍ṇāyai di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।
ō-nnama̠ḥ pratī̎chyai di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।
ō-nnama̠ udī̎chyai di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।
ō-nnama̍ ū̠rdhvāyai̍ di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।
ō-nnamō-'dha̍rāyai di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।
ō-nnamō̍-'vānta̠rāyai̍ di̠śē yāścha̍ dē̠vatā̍ ē̠tasyā̠-mprati̍vasantyē̠ tābhya̍ścha̠ nama̍ḥ ।

steps.title: muni namaskāraḥ
lines: namō gaṅgā yamunayō-rmadhyē yē̍ vasa̠nti̠ tē mē prasannātmāna śchirañjīvitaṃ
va̍rdhaya̠nti̠ namō gaṅgā yamunayō-rmuni̍bhyaścha̠ namō namō gaṅgā yamunayō-rmuni̍bhyaścha̠ na̍maḥ ॥

steps.title: sandhyādēvatā namaskāraḥ
lines: sandhyā̍yai̠ nama̍ḥ । sāvi̍tryai̠ nama̍ḥ । gāya̍tryai̠ nama̍ḥ ।
dē̠vēbhyō̠ nama̍ḥ । ṛṣi̍bhyō̠ nama̍ḥ । muni̍bhyō̠ nama̍ḥ ।
guru̍bhyō̠ nama̍ḥ । pitṛ̍bhyō̠ nama̍ḥ । kāmō-'kārṣī̎ rnamō̠ namaḥ ।
manyu rakārṣī̎ rnamō̠ namaḥ । pṛthivyāpastē̠jō vāyu̍rākā̠śāt namaḥ ॥ (tai. ara. 2.18.52)
ō-nnamō bhagavatē vāsu̍dēvā̠ya । yā̠gṃ sadā̍ sarvabhūtā̠ni̠ cha̠rāṇi̍ sthāva̠rāṇi̍ cha ।
namō brahmaṇya dēvāya gō brāhmaṇa hitāya cha ।

steps.title: gāyatrī udvāsana (prasthānaṃ)
lines: stutō mayā varadā vē̍damā̠tā̠ prachōdayantī pavanē̎ dvijā̠tā ।

steps.title: bhagavannamaskāraḥ
lines: namō-'stvanantāya sahasramūrtayē sahasra pādākṣi śirōru bāhavē ।
sahasra nāmnē puruṣāya śāśvatē sahasrakōṭī yuga dhāriṇē namaḥ ॥

steps.title: bhūmyākāśābhi vandanaṃ
lines: i̠da-ndyā̍vā pṛthi̠vī sa̠tyama̍stu̠ । pita̠-rmātaryadi̠ hōpa̍ bṛ̠vēvā̎m ।
bhū̠ta-ndē̠vānā̍ mavamē avō̍bhiḥ । vidyā mē̠ṣaṃ vṛ̠jina̍-ñjī̠radā̍num ॥

steps.title: abhivādaḥ (pravara)
lines: ... pravarānvita ... gōtraḥ ... sūtraḥ ... śākhādhyāyī ... aha-mbhō abhivādayē ॥

steps.title: īśvarārpaṇaṃ
lines: kāyēna vāchā manasēndriyairvā buddhyā-''tmanā vā prakṛtē ssvabhāvāt ।
